description: Manage private saved opportunity searches: list/create/events/delete/rotate_feed/delete_workspace. Requires Authorization Bearer workspace key configured in the client headers, never tool arguments. Ask before creating or deleting. Public research tools do not require this key.

active.description: Filter by source active status; this does not mean the response deadline is open.

after.description: Last notice ID from next_after in the preceding page.

agency.description: Agency code on the source notice.

generation.description: Retained generation UUID from a prior result for a consistent snapshot.

limit.description: Maximum notices to return, from 1 to 50; defaults to 25.

naics.description: Two- to six-digit NAICS industry code from a notice or the NAICS reference collection.

q.description: Plain-language keywords; empty returns notices matching the other filters.

set_aside.description: Official set-aside code from a notice or the set-asides reference collection.

state.description: State or territory code for the place of performance.

criteria.description: Opportunity filters for create; the server chooses the current generation.

id.description: Saved search UUID for events, delete, or rotate_feed.

name.description: Human-readable name for a new saved search; at most 100 characters.

operation.description: Action to perform: list, create, events, delete, rotate_feed, or delete_workspace.

name: saved_searches

JsonObject.description: Source-specific JSON map. The envelope is stable; map keys vary by official source.

feed_path.description: Present for create or feed rotation.

watches.description: Present for list; each watch includes status, criteria and event count.

title: Manage saved searches
